title: O'Connell 2009 outer AF circumferential transition strain (degenerate)

source.authors: O'Connell GD, Guerin HL, Elliott DM
source.sample: outer anterior AF samples from L3-L4 and L4-L5 discs of 7 cadaveric lumbar spines; 7 nondegenerate (36-53 y, grade 2.2+-0.3) and 6 degenerate (53-80 y, grade 3.9+-0.7) samples per direction

protocol.summary: Outer anterior AF strips: circumferential 15.8x2.8x1.9 mm, axial 11.1x2.3x1.5 mm, radial 14.2x2.5x1.8 mm (length x width x thickness); preload 10 min at 0.1 N (circ, axial) or 0.05 N (radial); 20 preconditioning cycles 0-2% strain; uniaxial quasi-static ramp to failure region (rate per earlier protocol, not restated); 2D Lagrangian strain by digital image correlation (Vic2D); Lagrangian (1st Piola) stress = force / undeformed CSA; toe and linear moduli and transition strain from bilinear analysis; axial analysed below 20% strain (linear). Nondegenerate data re-analysed from the authors' earlier study.
how_to_simulate: Build a strip of outer anterior AF with the stated dimensions and fibre orientation, gripped at both ends
Apply small preload, then quasi-static uniaxial extension
Compute Lagrangian stress (force/undeformed area) vs optical Lagrangian strain at the centre; fit toe/linear moduli and transition strain

extraction.check_notes: Table 1 (text layer of PMC author manuscript, column alignment checked). Tables 2-3 are model fits - not extracted.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
